fichas.title: Dependent and stacked parking systems
fichas.summary: Private parking systems include dependent vehicle platforms, inclined systems, independent parking above one another, and multi-level parking lifts. Systems should accommodate larger-than-normal vehicles. Parking lifts may be electrically operated or operated by hand pump during power cuts; a lift can handle up to three cars. The text states a loading limit per parking space and a maximum gradient for driving into and out of the garage.
uses: Parking up to three cars using a parking lift

fichas.title: Parking platforms and space-saving layouts
fichas.summary: Parking platforms can move lengthways or sideways to improve parking capacity and access. Lengthways-moving platforms are operated at the touch of a button, and unoccupied platforms can be driven over. Sideways-moving platforms are used where additional depth can provide multiple rows of parking but access space would otherwise be lost. The page also illustrates parking-space plans and a 360-degree turntable.
uses: Reaching parking spaces behind a stationary row

fichas.title: Combilift parking levels
fichas.summary: The page shows combilift arrangements with two or three parking levels, including configurations with a pit. Diagrams label upper storey, ground floor, underground, entry/exit, and empty spaces. The illustrations provide several bay and level dimensions; the text also notes that parking systems should account for differing vehicle heights.
